goal: Prevent background threads from crashing without diagnostics when storage media becomes unavailable
Log descriptive error details to stderr and debug logs when disk space checks encounter filesystem errors
agreement: Contested approach: multiple reviewers object to low-level aborts instead of graceful error propagation
Termination in low-level primitives prevents callers from handling errors cleanly (josibake)
Unclean aborts prevent critical subsystems like the wallet or chainstate from flushing (furszy)
Utility aborts bypass thread exception handling that could trigger orderly shutdown (sedited, optout21)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because handling rare filesystem exceptions during disk checks targets an uncommon edge case
Diagnostic logging is useful for media failures but the fix is reasonably deferrable
